Staining your floors isn’t just for style and looks-it can prevent scratches and save your floors from damage. When you need to protect the floors in your Natchitoches, Alexandria & Dry Prong, LA home, church, shop or other property, turn to Rock Hard Coatings LA to do the job right.

We can apply gray or brown stain anywhere you need it. We customize our concrete staining and sealing services to match your needs, ensuring safety from water damage and deep scratches. Floor sealing is a quick process; and we can do it in just a day.

Take care of your floors with staining services that fit your style. Contact us today to get started on defending your floors against water, dirt, and grime.

We also offer: Polished Concrete | Wood-Look Concrete | Cool Crete

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.17.6″ _module_preset=”c3c1179e-80e4-4396-b700-51b845e1c46f” header_font_size=”24px” header_2_font=”Khand|700|||||||” header_2_text_color=”#000000″ header_2_font_size=”32px” custom_margin=”||4px|||” header_font_size_tablet=”24px” header_font_size_phone=”20px” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_2_font_size_tablet=”32px” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Concrete staining comes in a variety of forms. We can stain and seal your floors with:

Acrylic sealer | Urethane sealer | Polyaspartic sealer

With proper floor sealing at your Natchitoches, Alexandria & Dry Prong, LA property, you can enjoy waterproof surfaces that look great and stand up against regular wear and tear. Depend on Rock Hard Coatings LA to cover your floors with quality sealers by emailing us now.
